messages.en: There's so much work today. Let's help each other out, okay?
Sure. I've finished my part. Want me to check yours?
Wow, send me a photo! I want to see the snow there.
The drain behind the house is blocked. The water just won't drain away.
Oh, that explains it. I'll call management now.
Sam's already at the café. He's asking where we are.
Oh no, I'm only just about to leave the house. You go ahead. I'll meet you guys there.
Okay, I'll let Sam know in a bit. Don't be too late, okay?
